prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Caldera Wildfire Detection and Suppression Support System: advisory-only; incident command retains authority; humans accept/reject/verify; no autonomous dispatch/control/release. Mandatory segmentation/time-sync/health-checks/audit-logging. Actors: local fire agencies, county emergency management, state wildland fire resources, aviation support units, cooperating public safety partners. Caldera Incident Command Portal (Emberhall): Duty Detection Officer (Orion), County Emergency Liaison, command staff; evidence/recommendations/status; threshold triage; searchable advance/hold/dismiss reasons; no suppression-assignment/public-notification. North Lookout Camera Mast sends Thermal Spot Snippet; South Lookout Camera Mast produces Camera Cleaning Log; both inform smoke-visibility assessment. Observations require timestamp/georeference/equipment-status. Horizon Ridge Drone Dock (Kestrel): launch/recovery/charging/shelter/health/security; maintenance threshold triggers Battery Swap Ticket. Drone Tasking Service manages approved requests/constraints/status; shall not task launches conflicting with active aviation lanes. Drone Pilot Operator reviews routes/constraints and launch safety/compliance. Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine (Lantern): fusion/traceability; Smoke Classifier Module produces Ridge Shadow Mask; scores cannot declare fire. Confirmation requires persistent smoke/thermal plus independent corroboration or recorded authorized visual judgment; stale/inconsistent/low-confidence evidence stays triaged. Confirmed Ignition State enables planning: location/confidence/history/reviewer/coordination-posture. MesoWest Weather Fusion Node (Brindle): weather/quality-checks; sends Wind Shift Bulletin; supplies aviation wind/visibility. Talon Air Tanker Dispatch Console (Marigold): maintains aviation lanes/status. Air Attack Supervisor (Redtail) deconflicts all aircraft routes before drone launch; checks restrictions against engine perimeter intelligence before air-asset release. Tanker Base Manager sequences availability/checks East Retardant Loading Pump/West Retardant Loading Pump readiness before assignment acceptance; East produces Retardant Batch Slip after metering/sealing. Crewline Mobile Tablet: Helitack Crew Leader receives command-released confirmed information. VHF Radio Gateway Repeater (Badger) bridges degraded command/air-to-ground/county paths; preserve available speaker identity. Failed bridge: Portal marks impairment; Orion manually acknowledges/verifies alternate contact before new aviation messages. County Emergency Liaison handles dispatch/roads/evacuation/notifications; sends Drone Corridor Permit after jurisdiction review; constraints must enter Portal before briefing. Airspace Restricted State requires authority-accepted restrictions requested

New part:
S096: The Smoke Classifier Module may be temporarily down-weighted by the Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine when observation quality is suspected to be degraded.
S097: The Helitack Crew Leader uses the Crewline Mobile Tablet to acknowledge air-to-ground instructions and report whether crews are inside any planned drop or reconnaissance area.
S098: The Caldera Incident Command Portal displays crew acknowledgements beside aviation tasks so the Air Attack Supervisor can verify that ground resources are clear before authorizing flight activity.
S099: If the Confirmed Ignition State is active and airspace approval is delayed, the system keeps suppression planning visible while preventing premature aircraft dispatch.
S100: Coordination records are retained with timestamps, participant identities, and radio path status so post-incident review can reconstruct both aviation decisions and interagency notifications.
S101: This section defines how the system converts detection observations, aerial imagery, weather updates, and geospatial overlays into a shared fire behavior assessment for operational use.
S102: The assessment begins when visual detections are correlated with incident geometry, terrain, fuel type, and current resource locations in the mapping workspace.
S103: North Lookout Camera Mast captures a time-stamped smoke column bearing and reports the pan, tilt, zoom, and confidence values needed to project the observation onto terrain.
S104: South Lookout Camera Mast supplies a separate bearing track so the mapping workflow can triangulate a probable origin area and bound the uncertainty ellipse.
S105: The Smoke Classifier Module assigns each observation a smoke likelihood, growth trend, and obscuration flag before the result is made available for analyst review.
S106: The Duty Detection Officer uses the spot snippet to compare the automated classification with visible flame, smoke color, and terrain context before accepting the observation into the assessment queue.
S107: Drone imagery is treated as a higher-resolution confirmation layer when weather, airspace, and communications conditions permit flight operations.
S108: The Drone Tasking Service packages approved imaging objectives as map footprints, altitude bands, and revisit intervals so the requested coverage can be compared with the active perimeter model.
S109: The Drone Pilot Operator uses the swap ticket to keep imaging sorties aligned with available aircraft endurance and expected return time.
S110: Frames collected during a sortie are orthorectified against the terrain model and registered to the incident grid before they are used for perimeter adjustment.
S111: The Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine identifies heat signatures, smoke edges, flame fronts, and potential spot fire indicators in the registered imagery.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
